verification_rule: HARDEN-* identifies a draft engineering control, not a canonical requirement. ADDRESSED means implementation/schema/tests exist on the named draft branch. A control is not VERIFIED until the configured runner executes the mapped tests successfully. canonical_requirement_refs may contain only IDs present in config/requirement_registry_v1.json.

controls.statement: FinancialSnapshot v2 must reject non-finite or cross-language-unsafe numeric inputs, enforce its existing accounting invariants before hashing, serialize economic decimals into one canonical textual representation, and match the shared Python/Node conformance fixture.

MaturitySnapshot v1 must preserve the contractual maturity curve while separately exporting a non-callable curve so immediately callable principal is not counted again in future LCR outflows; one snapshot remains single-denomination and decimal values are canonical.

SettlementReceipt v1 must export only observed fees, require an explicit closed economic_role for every fee, use canonical finite decimal text, preserve final route/output facts, and never classify payment principal/notional as fee P&L.

ProjectProposal v2 must preserve v1 for provenance while exporting fractional economics as canonical decimal strings and rejecting non-finite floats or unsafe integers from content-addressed federation payloads.

Trust commitments must bind project.proposal/v2 to its own PROJECT_PROPOSAL logical domain; superseded project.proposal/v1 is preserved for provenance but rejected for new canonical commitments, and project proposal bytes cannot be reinterpreted as project.screening/v1.
